units.source_text: 白居易新乐府《陵园妾》诗中有云：“陵园妾，颜色如花命如叶。

en.t: In Bai Juyi's New Yuefu poem 'The Concubine of the Imperial Mausoleum,' there are these lines: 'Concubine of the mausoleum, her beauty is like a flower, her life like a leaf.
When life is as fragile as a leaf, what can be done?'

units.source_text: 下文又云：“松门到晓月徘徊，柏城尽日风萧瑟。……”

en.t: Later the poem also says: 'At the pine gate the moon lingers until dawn; around the cypress walls the wind sighs desolately all day long...'
